hooks.command: e="${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; if [ -n "$e" ]; then [ -d "$e" ] || { echo "invalid Codex project directory: $e" >&2; exit 2; }; e="$(cd "$e" && pwd -P)" || { echo "cannot resolve Codex project directory: $e" >&2; exit 2; }; fi; p="$(pwd -P)" || exit 2; if [ -n "$e" ]; then case "$p/" in "$e/"*) ;; *) p="$e" ;; esac; fi; s="$p"; g="$(git -C "$p" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || :)"; if [ -n "$g" ]; then g="$(cd "$g" && pwd -P)" || { echo "cannot resolve Git worktree root: $g" >&2; exit 2; }; case "$p/" in "$g/"*) ;; *) echo "hook start escapes resolved Git worktree root: $p is not under $g" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; else g="${e:-$p}"; fi; while :; do d="$p/.codex/hooks"; h="$d/check-reviewer.sh"; if [ -e "$d" ] || [ -L "$d" ]; then [ -d "$d" ] && [ ! -L "$d" ] && [ -f "$h" ] && [ ! -L "$h" ] && [ -x "$h" ] || { echo "nearest Codex policy hook is missing, unsafe, or not executable: $h" >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$h"; fi; [ "$p" = / ] && break; [ "$p" = "$g" ] && break; n="$(dirname "$p")"; [ "$n" != "$p" ] || break; p="$n"; done; echo "no active .codex/hooks/check-reviewer.sh from $s to $g" >&2; exit 2
